note: agent-decomposed 2026-11-21 (stasis round 2). Four-stage execution order for the portable-app lifecycle. Stage 1 contract surfaces exist on disk (crates/elohim-sdk lifecycle, seam-contracts demand.rs, bridges/browser and bridges/workspace gate projects) and are CLAIMED pending their gate receipts; stages 2-4 found no producer code 2026-11-21.

items.text: Stage 1: compile lifecycle interfaces with explicit unsupported defaults and generated TS types
Stage 1: generic bounded demand leases below the SDK; per-device retained progress
Stage 1 verify: real gate results for app-lifecycle-contracts, elohim-sdk, seam-contracts, browser-bridge, workspace-bridge recorded in release-retention
Stage 2: node adapter for ensure-instance reusing Ark, first consumer the native declared-view reader
Stage 2: scoped outbound WSS service attachment to doorway HTTPS with bounded frames, expiry, reconnect, revocation in the producer schema
Stage 2 proof: real sign-in, repeat launch, revocation, different-person refusal, tampering, restart, interruption on the real Che hostname
Stage 3: release artifact declaration and compatibility selection for native targets; acquire and verify the executable dependency set
Stage 3: continuation preparation and activation with a durable operation identity; acquisition pins, archive and idle reclamation
Stage 3 proof: coding and orchard with the same client, shell takeover, cold offline reopen, corruption/full-disk recovery
Stage 4: inventory app bundles from manifests and migrate main client, Avodah, Lamad and shell onto SDK contracts
Stage 4: AppObservationJournal around ObservationEmitter with checked local append before acknowledgement
Stage 4 proof: cold restart, serving processes stopped, offline accumulation, low power, idle-at-rest; browser receipt per app
